concepts.proposed_markdown: The Basic Filters editor always creates a streaming billable metric. Its worked API-call example matches event type `api_request`, filters `status` to `success`, requires `user_id` to exist, uses `COUNT`, and groups the result by `user_id`; the equivalent API payload expresses those choices with `event_type_filter.in_values`, `property_filters`, `aggregation_type`, and nested `group_keys`. The example does not define general multi-filter boolean rules, include/exclude precedence, coercion, duplicate handling, time windows, late events, or when matching begins.
warnings: Keep the worked example separate from undocumented general filter-composition semantics.
Do not infer ingestion latency, deduplication, retroactivity, reflow, or metric-edit behavior from this page.
